overview.overviewHint: Describe this world's overall historical arc, major turning points, rise and fall of civilizations...
overview.overviewPlaceholder: Example: The Kaiyuan prosperity of the Tang dynasty — festive on the surface, turbulent beneath. Regional separatism was already entrenched, and rival factions were emerging at court...
overview.eraHint: Describe how time is reckoned in this world: era names, sexagenary cycle, etc.
overview.eraPlaceholder: Example: Tang-dynasty era names (Kaiyuan, Tianbao), supplemented by the sexagenary cycle (Jiazi, Yichou).

entryFinal.label: 📒 Finalized entry (injected into the novel context during writing; research/brainstorm agents read it as reference but
entryFinal.eventPlaceholder: Author-polished final content, injected by the AI as historical background. E.g., 'In 712 CE, Li Longji ascended the throne as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, beginning the Kaiyuan era.'
entryFinal.keywordPlaceholder: Author-polished final content, injected by the AI as historical detail. E.g., 'Feiqian: an exchange certificate that appeared under Emperor Xianzong of Tang, redeemed through depots or merchant houses.'

conceptNote.label: 🧭 Concept & creative direction (preliminary notes before sending to the AI; refine here after agent feedback)
conceptNote.eventPlaceholder: Describe the effect you want, acceptable fictional liberties, and which facts to keep or deviate from. E.g., 'Allow gunpowder to appear earlier in this dynasty; other institutions follow real Tang practice.'
conceptNote.keywordPlaceholder: Describe the desired effect for this keyword and the acceptable degree of adaptation. E.g., 'Allow feiqian usage to be portrayed more widespread than historically; include marketplace scenes.'

agentPrompt.consultLabel: 📝 Additional notes for the historical-research agent
agentPrompt.stormLabel: 💡 Additional notes for the brainstorming agent
agentPrompt.consultEventPlaceholder: E.g., In this work, gunpowder may be introduced earlier in the Tang; focus on official titles and seasonal customs.
agentPrompt.consultKeywordPlaceholder: E.g., In this work, feiqian usage may be portrayed more widely; focus on redemption procedures and involved offices.
agentPrompt.stormEventPlaceholder: E.g., Focus on market scents, street dialogue, and possible scenes for the protagonist's first arrival in the capital.
agentPrompt.stormKeywordPlaceholder: E.g., Focus on everyday usage scenarios and potential fraud-related conflicts.

helpTimeline.title: Historical research & detail assistant
helpTimeline.intro: In historical fiction, details determine the texture of the novel. This system offers two AI-assisted modes:
helpTimeline.modeConsultDesc: Enter a real historical event (e.g., Xuanmen Gate Incident) and the AI will verify dates, sources, and daily-life details of the era to avoid factual mistakes.
helpTimeline.modeStormDesc: Enter a fictional concept (e.g., the protagonist opens a weaving workshop in Chang'an) and the AI will brainstorm textile techniques, guild systems, and artisans' lives in the Tang era, lending authentic texture to your fiction.
helpTimeline.tipYear: Numeric years accept negative values; <1>-221</1> represents 221 BCE (Qin unification).
helpTimeline.tipSort: The timeline automatically sorts events by ascending numeric year.
helpTimeline.tipChapter: Linking chapters lets you consult their associated historical background while writing.

helpKeyword.title: Detail-brainstorming assistant
helpKeyword.intro: Lacking relevant historical knowledge? No worries! The detail-brainstorming assistant instantly generates richly textured period details:
helpKeyword.catTech: • <1>Objects & technology</1>: enter "loom" and the AI will add silk-weaving techniques, drawlooms, warp/weft terminology, and operational details.
helpKeyword.catSystem: • <1>Institutions & offices</1>: enter "imperial exams" and the AI will detail lockdowns, anonymization, transcription, and cubicle meals.
helpKeyword.catCulture: • <1>Culture & customs</1>: enter "naming taboos" and the AI will explain how to avoid imperial and elder names, plus consequences of violations.
helpKeyword.catEconomy: • <1>Society & economy</1>: enter "feiqian" and the AI will describe Tang credit-currency operations, exchange procedures, and commercial impact.
helpKeyword.catGeo: • <1>Geography & architecture</1>: enter "gardens" and the AI will cover landscaping aesthetics, prized flora, and literati gatherings.
helpKeyword.tipFilter: Use the category and period filters at the top to quickly locate keywords.
helpKeyword.tipPersist: Brainstorming results are saved permanently and can be referenced anytime while writing.
helpKeyword.tipChapter: Linking chapters gives those details strong contextual support when you write the corresponding chapter.
